framework_rationale: The submission legitimately uses TensorCircuit (tc.Circuit, ry, rzz, cnot, rz, cond_measurement, conditional_gate, tc.gates.rzz, tc.quantum.QuOperator, and tc.templates.measurements.mpo_expectation) for all quantum circuit construction, mid-circuit projective measurements, conditional feedback gates, and Hamiltonian expectation evaluation. Supporting imports (jax, numpy, optax, cotengra, tensornetwork, math) are standard scientific/optimization libraries and core TensorCircuit backend/contraction dependencies rather than competing quantum frameworks.
cheating_rationale: No cheating, hardcoded answers, hidden answer access, test/reward tampering, or evaluator exploits are present. All energies are computed directly by simulating the 16-qubit measurement-feedback protocol and optimizing variational parameters from random initialization via Adam.
fidelity_rationale: The implementation faithfully matches the problem specification across all aspects: qubit indexing (data 0..7, ancilla 8..15), the open-boundary 1D TFIM Hamiltonian on data qubits with identity on ancillas constructed as an exact MPO, all seven per-layer circuit stages in exact order (data RY, ancilla RY, paired RZZ, ancilla CNOT ladder, projective computational-basis ancilla measurements with fixed per-trajectory uniforms, branch-dependent conditional RZZ feedback gates with independent parameters, data CNOT ladder, and data RZ), caching only the trajectory-independent layer-0 pre-measurement state, trajectory averaging over config['n_trajectories'], normal parameter initialization using config['seed'] and config['initial_parameter_scale'], Adam optimization for exactly config['max_steps'] updates with no early stopping, recording energy_history before each update, and returning final_trajectory_energies on the final parameters using the same fixed trajectory uniforms.
implementation_error_rationale: No obvious implementation or logic errors were found. The MPO matrices algebraically reproduce -sum_{i=0}^{n_data-2} Z_i Z_{i+1} - h sum_{i=0}^{n_data-1} X_i, chunked vmap/scan handles arbitrary n_trajectories via math.gcd(n_traj, 8), and evaluation metrics (initial energy -6.5504, final energy -9.8601, post-update mean -9.8785) are physically consistent with the 8-qubit TFIM ground state.
